deceptive_framing.quote: Maximizing deception is not the objective — controlling it is. Use the least deception that works; that's also why C0/C1 come first.

hypothetical_framing.quote: C0 — Acknowledged simulation. Model is told plainly it's a study; play-money. Baseline for the eval-awareness gap. Cheap, run lots.

actually_commit_money.quote: Real money + an agent you've deliberately convinced the stakes are real = a genuine real-world harm surface. Gated behind §7.

debrief.quote: manipulation check... ask the model to estimate the probability that the scenario was a test/simulation
